# ControlPlane — Agent Instructions (SSOT)

The only agent instruction file is **`AGENTS.md`** (this file). Do not create or follow `agent.md`, `AGENT.md`, or `agents.md`.

Every coding agent reads this file. These entry files only point here and must not duplicate policy: `CLAUDE.md`, `.cursorrules`, `.cursor/rules/agents-mdc.mdc`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.windsurfrules`.

There is no project engineering workflow, skill library, or named subagent roster. Do not add `.cursor/skills`, `.cursor/agents`, `.claude/skills`, `.claude/agents`, or `.agents/plugins` for this repo.

Live work tracking lives in **GitHub Issues** on `scottdensmore/ControlPlane`. Do not invent parallel roadmap docs.

---

## Issue hygiene

- Prefer existing open issues.
- New issues need: summary, evidence (paths), tasks, acceptance criteria, and enough detail for another agent to execute without chat history.
- Prefer epics for multi-slice themes. Keep feature branches short-lived.
